source.snippet: I tend to nuke my entire db, recreate it and reload some data into it. I wish there was a tool that ran in watch mode and patched the db based schema edits.

problem_statement: Developers iterating rapidly on SQLite schemas during early-stage development have no watch-mode tool that automatically detects schema file changes and applies non-destructive migrations, forcing them to manually nuke and recreate the database on each iteration.
target_segment: Solo developers and small teams using SQLite for local development or prototyping, particularly in Python, Rust, or JS stacks
notes: Lightweight, well-scoped tool opportunity. Could be a small CLI or VS Code extension. Analogous to how css/js watchers work but for SQLite DDL. Likely quick to build and validate.
